relevance_rank_note: Indirect test of H2: in vivo APOE3 vs APOE4 targeted-replacement mice, measures only total Apoer2/Lrp1 immunoreactivity and mRNA in hippocampal neurons (lower Apoer2 protein with unchanged mRNA, consistent with but not demonstrating post-endocytic loss); no surface, recycling or ARF6 readout and no astrocytes.

description: Total Apoer2 immunoreactivity in hippocampal CA3 pyramidal neurons of naive 4-month-old APOE4 targeted-replacement mice was 31% of the APOE3 level (Table 1, ApoE4 expressed as percent of ApoE3, not a percent reduction), while hippocampal Apoer2 mRNA was unchanged.
quote: The levels of Apoer2 were significantly lower in the CA3 and CA1 neurons of the ApoE4 mice than in those of the corresponding ApoE3 mice (P<0.0001 for CA3 and P<0.005 for CA1).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less total Apoer2 protein in CA3 neurons, mRNA unchanged)
system: Human APOE3 vs APOE4 targeted-replacement mice (homozygous 3/3 vs 4/4, backcrossed 10 generations to C57BL/6J), 4-month-old males, naive; perfusion-fixed 30 um coronal sections, anti-Apoer2 C-terminal Ab immunofluorescence, confocal, percent area above threshold per subfield. Mouse in vivo; hippocampal neurons.
human_check: eff 31% is ApoE4 as percent of ApoE3 (Table 1: 31+/-5), i.e. a 69% reduction; not converted. Figure images (PMC author manuscript Figs 1, 2, 3, 5) checked by the referee; bar values and stars match Table 1. Total level is a surrogate for surface/recycling; the paper only cites ref 42 for a trapping mechanism.

description: Hippocampal Apoer2 mRNA measured by TaqMan qRT-PCR (normalised to Hprt-1) did not differ between naive APOE4 and APOE3 mice; the authors use this to argue the Apoer2 protein decrease is post-transcriptional (Lrp1 mRNA likewise unchanged, Fig 2B). No P value is printed for the mRNA comparison.
quote: RT-PCR experiments revealed no differences in hippocampal Apoer2 mRNA levels between the ApoE4 and ApoE3 mice (Fig. 1B), suggesting that the ApoE4-driven decrease in Apoer2 is post transcriptional.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in Apoer2 mRNA) -> (protein loss is post-transcriptional)
system: Human APOE3 vs APOE4 targeted-replacement mice, 4-month-old males, naive; snap-frozen whole hippocampus, TaqMan qRT-PCR for Apoer2 (Lrp8) normalised to Hprt-1. Mouse in vivo; whole-hippocampus homogenate (mixed cell types).
human_check: Class 5: an mRNA null that supports a post-transcriptional (possibly trafficking/degradation) mechanism rather than measuring B; marked against=false because it does not contradict H2. Effect recorded as qualitative from text; figure not viewed (403).

description: After 4 days of i.c.v. thiorphan (neprilysin inhibition) or sham, total Apoer2 immunoreactivity in CA1 neurons did not differ between APOE4 and APOE3 mice (Table 1: 114% of ApoE3, N.S.; also unchanged at 10 days, data not shown); authors note sham surgery itself abolished the naive APOE4 Apoer2 deficit. The paper marks this N.S. but prints no numeric P.
quote: Measuring the levels of Apoer2 in CA1 neurons, following inhibition of neprilysin, revealed that, unlike Lrp1, they were the same in the sham- and thiorphan-treated ApoE4 and ApoE3 mice at both 4 days (Fig. 5)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, + thiorphan or sham) -> (no change in total CA1 Apoer2)
system: Human APOE3 vs APOE4 targeted-replacement mice, 4-month-old males, i.c.v. infusion of neprilysin inhibitor thiorphan 0.5 mM (Alzet 2004 pump, 0.25 ul/h) or sham aCSF for 4 days; perfusion-fixed 30 um coronal sections, anti-Apoer2 C-terminal Ab immunofluorescence, confocal, percent area above threshold per subfield. Mouse in vivo; hippocampal CA1 neurons; amyloid-cascade activation (thiorphan) plus cannula implantation context.
location: Fig 5 right (quantification; figure has no panel letters), Table 1
human_check: Table 1 gives 114+/-23 (N.S.) for the neprilysin-inhibition ApoE4 value as % ApoE3; the comparator is sham-treated ApoE3 (Fig 5 normalised to sham E3; treated E4 bar ~1.14). Versus treated E3 (~0.90) it would be ~1.27x. No numeric p. Sham-treated mice also show no genotype difference. Figure images (PMC author manuscript Figs 1, 2, 3, 5) checked by the referee; bar values and stars match Table 1.

description: After 4 days of i.c.v. thiorphan, total Lrp1 immunoreactivity in CA1 neurons rose in APOE4 but not APOE3 (or ApoE-KO) mice (Table 1: 430% of ApoE3), with unchanged CA1 Lrp1 mRNA and increased Lrp1 co-localisation with cathepsin D lysosomes (Fig 4); transient, back to baseline by 10 days.
quote: Quantification of these results revealed that the increase in Lrp1 levels in the thiorphan-treated ApoE4 mice, in relation to all other groups analyzed, was statistically significant (P<0.001; Fig. 3A).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, + thiorphan) -> (more total CA1 Lrp1, more lysosomal Lrp1)
system: Human APOE3 vs APOE4 targeted-replacement mice, 4-month-old males, i.c.v. infusion of neprilysin inhibitor thiorphan 0.5 mM (Alzet 2004 pump, 0.25 ul/h) or sham aCSF for 4 days; perfusion-fixed 30 um coronal sections, anti-Lrp1 C-terminal Ab immunofluorescence, confocal, percent area above threshold per subfield. Mouse in vivo; hippocampal CA1 neurons; amyloid-cascade activation (thiorphan) plus cannula implantation context.
human_check: Different context (amyloid-cascade activation), total Lrp1 increase is not a recycling readout; direction relative to H2 is ambiguous (not marked against). p<0.001 is ANOVA post hoc for thiorphan-ApoE4 vs all other groups, which includes thiorphan-ApoE3. Table 1 430+/-74 is relative to sham-treated ApoE3 (Fig 3A treated E4 ~4.3, sham E3 1.0); versus treated E3 (~0.92) it is ~4.7x. Figure images (PMC author manuscript Figs 1, 2, 3, 5) checked by the referee; bar values and stars match Table 1.
